newsitem.title: USA: Disney signs long term pact with Telepiu.
newsitem.headline: Disney signs long term pact with Telepiu.

text.p: Walt Disney Co. Wednesday signed a long term pay-per-view and exclusive pay television agreement with Telepiu, Italy's first pay television service.

In a statement, Disney/ABC International Television said the agreement runs for 10 years. Disney/ABC will license pay television and pay-per-view rights to Telepiu for live action feature films, including Disney, Hollywood, Touchstone and Miramax pictures. Telepiu will also carry a newly developed premium Disney channel for Italy on Telepiu's satellite starting in late 1997.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

The move is the latest in a series of agreements between Hollywood studios and European broadcasting companies looking to acquire American films and television programs to feed their growing satellite networks.

On Tuesday, French Pay TV channel Canal Plus entered into a long-term agreement with News Corporation unit 20th Century Fox allowing it to have rights for all Fox films for encrypted broadcasts. The "strategic alliance" also involved the development of channels to be carried on each company's networks around the world.
Telepiu, Italy's pay television operator, recently launched its digital direct home satellite service, Telepiu Satellite.

The service currently offers six channels in its basic tier, three premium channels and Telepiu Calcio, featuring Italian league soccer. In January, Telepiu will expand its offer with four new thematic channels and three premium channels for movies and sports when Telepiu's four additional transponders are operational.
Based in Milan, Telepiu is owned by Dutch-based media group Nethold, the Kirch Group and Fininvest. Nethold has recently agreed in principle to merge with Canal Plus.
